preconditions.description: The integer k must be between 2 and 12 inclusive, representing the size of the array as 2^k.
The array size must exactly match 2^k, where k is the first input line.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) < 2 ** int(stdin.split()[0]) for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each element in the array must be a non-negative integer less than 2^k.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutations exist, output 'Fou'. Otherwise, output 'Shi' followed by two lines of permutations p and q.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Shi' and all(0 <= int(x) < 2 ** int(stdin.split()[0]) for x in stdout.split()[1:]) and all(0 <= int(x) < 2 ** int(stdin.split()[0]) for x in stdout.split()[2:])
postconditions.description: If 'Shi' is output, the permutations p and q must consist of distinct integers between 0 and 2^k - 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Shi' and all(int(p) ^ int(q) == int(a) for p, q, a in zip(stdout.split()[1:], stdout.split()[2:], stdin.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For every i, the XOR of p_i and q_i must equal the corresponding a_i in the input array.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Shi' and len(set(stdout.split()[1:])) == 2 ** int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(set(stdout.split()[2:])) == 2 ** int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: The permutations p and q must be valid (all distinct elements).
